word: Life was like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get.
explains: 人生就像一盒巧克力，你永远不知道下一颗是什么味道。——《阿甘正传》

word: Stupid is as stupid does.
explains: 傻人有傻福。——《阿甘正传》

word: You have to put the past behind you before you can move on.
explains: 你必须放下过去，才能继续前行。——《阿甘正传》

word: Run, Forrest, run!
explains: 跑，阿甘，跑！——《阿甘正传》

word: Miracles happen every day.
explains: 奇迹每天都在发生。——《阿甘正传》

word: I don't know if we each have a destiny, or if we're all just floating around accidental-like on a breeze.
explains: 我不知道我们各自是否有命运，还是只是随风飘荡。——《阿甘正传》

word: Mama always said, dying was a part of life.
explains: 妈妈常说，死亡是人生的一部分。——《阿甘正传》

word: I am not a smart man, but I know what love is.
explains: 我不是聪明人，但我知道什么是爱。——《阿甘正传》

word: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things, and no good thing ever dies.
explains: 希望是美好的，也许是人间至善，而美好的事物永不消逝。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
explains: 恐惧让你沦为囚犯，希望让你重获自由。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: Get busy living, or get busy dying.
explains: 要么忙着生存，要么忙着去死。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: It takes a strong man to save himself, and a great man to save another.
explains: 强者自救，圣者渡人。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: Some birds aren't meant to be caged. Their feathers are just too bright.
explains: 有些鸟儿注定不会被关在笼中，它们的羽毛太鲜亮了。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: Salvation lies within.
explains: 得救之道，就在其中。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand.
explains: 我希望我能越过边境，见到我的朋友，握握他的手。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: The Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams.
explains: 太平洋蓝得就像我梦中的一样。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them.
explains: 这些墙很有意思，起初你恨它们，后来你习惯了它们。——《肖申克的救赎》

word: You jump, I jump.
explains: 你跳，我也跳。——《泰坦尼克号》

word: I'm the king of the world!
explains: 我是世界之王！——《泰坦尼克号》

word: I'll never let go, Jack.
explains: 我永远不会放手，杰克。——《泰坦尼克号》

word: Winning that ticket, Rose, was the best thing that ever happened to me.
explains: 赢得那张船票，罗丝，是我一生中最幸运的事。——《泰坦尼克号》

word: A woman's heart is a deep ocean of secrets.
explains: 女人的心是一片深藏着秘密的海洋。——《泰坦尼克号》

word: I'm flying!
explains: 我在飞！——《泰坦尼克号》

word: I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse.
explains: 我会给他一个他无法拒绝的条件。——《教父》

word: A man who doesn't spend time with his family can never be a real man.
explains: 不陪伴家人的男人，永远算不上真正的男人。——《教父》

word: Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.
explains: 亲近朋友，更要亲近敌人。——《教父》

word: Revenge is a dish best served cold.
explains: 复仇这道菜，放凉吃才最美味。——《教父》

word: Great men are not born great, they grow great.
explains: 伟人并非生而伟大，而是越活越伟大。——《教父》

word: Never hate your enemies. It affects your judgment.
explains: 永远不要憎恨你的敌人，那会影响你的判断。——《教父》

word: Leave the gun. Take the cannoli.
explains: 把枪留下，带上卡诺里蛋糕。——《教父》

word: It's not personal. It's strictly business.
explains: 这不是针对个人，纯粹是生意。——《教父》

word: You got a dream, you gotta protect it.
explains: 有梦想就要守护它。——《当幸福来敲门》

word: Don't ever let somebody tell you you can't do something.
explains: 永远别让任何人告诉你你不行。——《当幸福来敲门》

word: If you want something, go get it. Period.
explains: 想要什么就去争取，就这样。——《当幸福来敲门》

word: This part of my life is called "happyness".
explains: 我生命中的这一段，叫做「幸福」。——《当幸福来敲门》

word: Take a piano. The keys begin, the keys end.
explains: 拿钢琴来说，琴键有始也有终。——《海上钢琴师》

word: But never more than 88 keys.
explains: 琴键永远不会超过88个。——《海上钢琴师》

word: We laughed and kept saying "See you soon", but inside we both knew we'd never see each other again.
explains: 我们笑着说再见，心里却都明白再见遥遥无期。——《海上钢琴师》

word: All that city, you just couldn't see an end to it.
explains: 那座城市，你望不到它的尽头。——《海上钢琴师》

word: It wasn't what I saw that stopped me. It was what I didn't see.
explains: 让我停下来的不是我看到的，而是我没看到的。——《海上钢琴师》

word: Do not go gentle into that good night.
explains: 不要温和地走进那个良夜。——《星际穿越》

word: Rage, rage against the dying of the light.
explains: 怒斥，怒斥光明的消逝。——《星际穿越》

word: Love is the one thing we're capable of perceiving that transcends dimensions of time and space.
explains: 爱是唯一我们能感知到的、超越时空维度的东西。——《星际穿越》

word: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
explains: 人类生于地球，但绝不该在这里灭亡。——《星际穿越》

word: We've always defined ourselves by the ability to overcome the impossible.
explains: 我们总是以战胜不可能来定义自己。——《星际穿越》

word: You mustn't be afraid to dream a little bigger, darling.
explains: 亲爱的，做梦不妨再大胆一点。——《盗梦空间》

word: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
explains: 你的大脑就是犯罪现场。——《盗梦空间》

word: An idea is like a virus. Resilient, highly contagious.
explains: 想法就像病毒，坚韧且传染性极强。——《盗梦空间》

word: Never recreate places from your memory. Always imagine new places.
explains: 不要从记忆中重建场景，要去想象新的地方。——《盗梦空间》

word: Downwards is the only way forwards.
explains: 向下，是前进的唯一出路。——《盗梦空间》

word: You don't owe these people anymore. You've given them everything.
explains: 你不再亏欠这些人了，你已给了他们一切。——《盗梦空间》

word: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
explains: 沉溺于梦想而忘记生活，是不可取的。——《哈利·波特》

word: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
explains: 对于头脑清醒的人来说，死亡不过是另一场伟大的冒险。——《哈利·波特》

word: Happiness can be found, even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.
explains: 即使在最黑暗的时刻，只要记得点亮灯光，幸福就总能找到。——《哈利·波特》

word: We are only as strong as we are united, as weak as we are divided.
explains: 我们团结则强，分裂则弱。——《哈利·波特》

word: After all this time? Always.
explains: 这么多年了，一直如此。——《哈利·波特》

word: It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.
explains: 挺身对抗敌人需要勇气，对抗朋友同样需要勇气。——《哈利·波特》

word: Do not pity the dead, Harry. Pity the living.
explains: 不要怜悯死者，哈利，怜悯活着的人。——《哈利·波特》

word: Working hard is important. But there is something that matters even more: believing in yourself.
explains: 努力很重要，但更重要的是相信自己。——《哈利·波特》

word: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.
explains: 我们所能决定的，只是如何运用被赋予的时间。——《指环王》

word: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
explains: 再渺小的人也能改变未来的走向。——《指环王》

word: There is some good in this world, Mr. Frodo. And it's worth fighting for.
explains: 这世界上还是有美好的东西，弗罗多先生，值得为之奋斗。——《指环王》

word: A day may come when the courage of men fails... but it is not this day.
explains: 人类的勇气或许有耗尽的一天，但绝不是今天。——《指环王》

word: The world is changed. I feel it in the water. I feel it in the earth. I smell it in the air.
explains: 世界正在改变，我在水中、在大地中、在空气中都感受到了。——《指环王》

word: Not all those who wander are lost.
explains: 并非所有流浪者都迷失了方向。——《指环王》

word: My precious.
explains: 我的宝贝。——《指环王》

word: I would have followed you, my brother... my captain... my king.
explains: 我本愿追随你，我的兄弟、我的领袖、我的王。——《指环王》

word: A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins. Nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.
explains: 巫师从不迟到，弗罗多，也从不早到，他总会在该到的时候出现。——《指环王》

word: I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you!
explains: 我无法替你承担，但我可以背着你走！——《指环王》

word: You shall not pass!
explains: 你休想通过！——《指环王》

word: In Zootopia, anyone can be anything.
explains: 在动物城，每个人都能成就无限可能。——《疯狂动物城》

word: Life's a little bit messy. We all make mistakes.
explains: 生活有点乱，我们都会犯错。——《疯狂动物城》

word: No matter what type of animal you are, change starts with you.
explains: 不管你是谁，改变都从你开始。——《疯狂动物城》

word: It's called a hustle, sweetheart.
explains: 这叫智取，亲爱的。——《疯狂动物城》

word: The more we try to understand one another, the more exceptional each of us will be.
explains: 越是努力相互理解，我们每个人就越优秀。——《疯狂动物城》

word: Remember me.
explains: 请记住我。——《寻梦环游记》

word: Nothing is more important than family.
explains: 没有什么比家人更重要。——《寻梦环游记》

word: Music is not just in me. It is me.
explains: 音乐不只是在心里，音乐就是我。——《寻梦环游记》

word: Seize your moment.
explains: 抓住属于你的时刻。——《寻梦环游记》

word: Never forget how much your family loves you.
explains: 永远别忘了家人有多爱你。——《寻梦环游记》

word: Why so serious?
explains: 为什么这么严肃呢？——《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》

word: You either die a hero, or you live long enough to see yourself become the villain.
explains: 要么作为英雄死去，要么活得够久，看着自己被写成恶棍。——《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》

word: It's not who I am underneath, but what I do that defines me.
explains: 定义我的不是我内心的想法，而是我的行动。——《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》

word: Some men just want to watch the world burn.
explains: 有些人只想看着这个世界燃烧。——《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》

word: I believe whatever doesn't kill you simply makes you stranger.
explains: 我相信凡是杀不死你的，只会让你更怪异。——《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》

word: Why do we fall, sir? So that we can learn to pick ourselves up.
explains: 我们为什么会跌倒？为了能学会重新站起来。——《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》

word: They may take our lives, but they'll never take our freedom.
explains: 他们可以夺走我们的生命，但永远夺不走我们的自由。——《勇敢的心》

word: Every man dies, not every man really lives.
explains: 每个人都会死，但不是每个人都真正活过。——《勇敢的心》

word: Your heart is free. Have the courage to follow it.
explains: 你的心是自由的，要有勇气追随它。——《勇敢的心》

word: Freedom!
explains: 自由！——《勇敢的心》

word: Carpe diem. Seize the day, boys. Make your lives extraordinary.
explains: 抓住今天，孩子们，让生命不同寻常。——《死亡诗社》

word: O Captain! My Captain!
explains: 哦，船长！我的船长！——《死亡诗社》

word: No matter what anybody tells you, words and ideas can change the world.
explains: 不管别人怎么说，语言和思想可以改变世界。——《死亡诗社》

word: We don't read and write poetry because it's cute. We read and write poetry because we are members of the human race.
explains: 我们读诗写诗不是因为好玩，而是因为我们是人类的一员。——《死亡诗社》

word: After all, tomorrow is another day.
explains: 无论如何，明天又是新的一天。——《乱世佳人》

word: Frankly, my dear, I don't give a damn.
explains: 坦白说，亲爱的，我一点也不在乎。——《乱世佳人》

word: As God is my witness, I'll never be hungry again.
explains: 让上帝作证，我再也不要挨饿了。——《乱世佳人》

word: We'll always have Paris.
explains: 我们永远拥有巴黎。——《卡萨布兰卡》

word: Here's looking at you, kid.
explains: 敬你，孩子。——《卡萨布兰卡》

word: Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world, she walks into mine.
explains: 全世界那么多城镇，城镇里那么多酒馆，她却走进了我的。——《卡萨布兰卡》

word: May the Force be with you.
explains: 愿原力与你同在。——《星球大战》

word: Do. Or do not. There is no try.
explains: 要么做，要么不做，没有「试一试」。——《星球大战》

word: I am your father.
explains: 我是你的父亲。——《星球大战》

word: Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. You're my only hope.
explains: 救救我，欧比旺，你是我唯一的希望。——《星球大战》

word: Hakuna matata.
explains: 无忧无虑，别担心。——《狮子王》

word: Oh yes, the past can hurt. But you can either run from it, or learn from it.
explains: 是啊，过去会让人痛苦，但你可以选择逃避，也可以从中学习。——《狮子王》

word: Everything you see exists together in a delicate balance.
explains: 你所看到的一切都共存在一个微妙的平衡之中。——《狮子王》

word: Remember who you are.
explains: 记住你是谁。——《狮子王》

word: To infinity and beyond!
explains: 飞向宇宙，浩瀚无垠！——《玩具总动员》

word: You've got a friend in me.
explains: 我是你的好朋友。——《玩具总动员》

word: This isn't flying. This is falling with style!
explains: 这不是飞行，这是有风度的坠落！——《玩具总动员》

word: There is no secret ingredient. It's just you.
explains: 根本没有什么秘诀，秘诀就是你。——《功夫熊猫》

word: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.
explains: 昨天已成历史，明天还是谜团，只有今天是礼物，所以才叫现在。——《功夫熊猫》

word: One often meets his destiny on the road he takes to avoid it.
explains: 一个人往往在逃避命运的路上，与命运狭路相逢。——《功夫熊猫》

word: Your story may not have a happy beginning, but that doesn't make you who you are. It is the rest of your story, who you choose to be.
explains: 你的故事或许没有幸福的开头，但那并不能决定你是谁，你的故事如何续写、你选择成为谁，才决定你是谁。——《功夫熊猫》

word: All is well.
explains: 一切顺利。——《三傻大闹宝莱坞》

word: Chase excellence, and success will follow.
explains: 追求卓越，成功自会随之而来。——《三傻大闹宝莱坞》

word: It's not your fault.
explains: 这不是你的错。——《心灵捕手》

word: People call these things imperfections, but they're not. That's the good stuff.
explains: 人们称这些为不完美，但它们不是，那才是好东西。——《心灵捕手》

word: You'll have bad times, but it'll always wake you up to the good stuff you weren't paying attention to.
explains: 你会有不顺的时候，但它会让你清醒，看到那些你未曾留意的美好。——《心灵捕手》

word: There is no spoon.
explains: 根本就没有勺子。——《黑客帝国》

word: Free your mind.
explains: 解放你的思想。——《黑客帝国》

word: I know Kung Fu.
explains: 我会功夫了。——《黑客帝国》

word: I'm just a girl, standing in front of a boy, asking him to love her.
explains: 我只是一个女孩，站在一个男孩面前，请求他爱她。——《诺丁山》

word: Show me the money!
explains: 给我看看钱！——《甜心先生》

word: You had me at hello.
explains: 你开口说「你好」的那一刻，我就已经沦陷。——《甜心先生》

word: I'll be back.
explains: 我会回来的。——《终结者》

word: Houston, we have a problem.
explains: 休斯顿，我们遇到麻烦了。——《阿波罗13号》

word: Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the fairest of them all?
explains: 魔镜魔镜，谁是世上最美的人？——《白雪公主》

word: Just keep swimming.
explains: 一直游下去就对了。——《海底总动员》

word: Adventure is out there.
explains: 冒险就在前方。——《飞屋环游记》

word: Anyone can cook.
explains: 人人都能烹饪。——《美食总动员》

word: Not everyone can become a great artist, but a great artist can come from anywhere.
explains: 并非人人都能成为伟大的艺术家，但伟大的艺术家可以来自任何地方。——《美食总动员》

word: Find the joy in your life.
explains: 找到你生命中的快乐。——《遗愿清单》

word: Good morning, and in case I don't see you, good afternoon, good evening, and good night!
explains: 早安！万一见不到你，祝你午安、晚安！——《楚门的世界》

word: We accept the reality of the world with which we're presented.
explains: 我们都接受呈现在面前的世界的样子。——《楚门的世界》

word: I gotta keep breathing. Because tomorrow the sun will rise. Who knows what the tide could bring?
explains: 我必须继续呼吸，因为明天太阳会升起，谁知道潮水会带来什么。——《荒岛余生》

word: Whoever saves one life saves the world entire.
explains: 拯救一条生命，就是拯救整个世界。——《辛德勒的名单》

word: It is only in the mysterious equations of love that any logic or reasons can be found.
explains: 只有在爱的神秘方程中，才能找到逻辑与理由。——《美丽心灵》

word: The problem is not the problem. The problem is your attitude about the problem.
explains: 问题本身不是问题，你对问题的态度才是问题。——《加勒比海盗》

word: Why is the rum always gone?
explains: 朗姆酒为什么总是喝光了？——《加勒比海盗》

word: I see you.
explains: 我看见你了（我懂你）。——《阿凡达》

word: I love you 3000.
explains: 我爱你三千遍。——《复仇者联盟》

word: I am Iron Man.
explains: 我是钢铁侠。——《复仇者联盟》

word: Avengers, assemble.
explains: 复仇者，集结。——《复仇者联盟》

word: Let it go.
explains: 随它去吧。——《冰雪奇缘》

word: Love is putting someone else's needs before yours.
explains: 爱就是把别人的需要放在自己之前。——《冰雪奇缘》

word: May the odds be ever in your favor.
